name: Nipa palm drink
summary: Dừa nước is the nipa drink at the garden stop, beside the sampan and the bicycle. It is not the young coconut on the firefly boat.
origin: The near-town garden on the provincial tourism portal’s 48-hour day.
howToEat: Drink it at that garden stop. The portal does not say whether it is the sap or the fruit. Young coconut water is the glass on the firefly boat.
where: The garden the town boats use. The portal’s 2024 wording places that stop in xã Phú Nhuận.
seoTitle: Nipa drink in Ben Tre — dừa nước
seoDescription: Dừa nước is the nipa drink at the garden stop. It is not the young coconut on the firefly boat.
